item.title: It Took 50 Years to Prove That Ted Bundy Did This
item.description: More than five decades after Laura Ann Aime was killed in Utah, advanced DNA testing confirmed Ted Bundy’s involvement. Preserved evidence allowed investigators to establish the forensic link that had been missing for years and officially close her 1974 murder case.

item.title: Susana Morales Was Killed by a Police Officer
item.description: Sixteen-year-old Susana Morales disappeared while walking home in Georgia in July 2022. The investigation led to Doraville police officer Miles Bryant, who was later convicted of kidnapping, murder and filing a false crime report. He received life in prison without parole.

item.title: Bella Fontenelle and the Evidence Against Hannah Landon
item.description: Six-year-old Bella Fontenelle was killed in Harahan, Louisiana, in April 2023. The investigation led to her father’s girlfriend, Hannah Landon, who was convicted of first-degree murder and obstruction of justice in 2025 and sentenced to life without parole plus 80 years.

item.title: Larry Rudolph Claimed His Wife Died in a Hunting Accident
item.description: Bianca Rudolph was fatally shot during a hunting trip in Zambia in 2016. Her husband Larry claimed it was an accident and collected nearly $4.9 million in life insurance. A federal jury convicted him of murder and mail fraud, and he was sentenced to life in prison.
